title: Zelenskyy says excluding Ukraine from US-Russia talks about war ‘very dangerous’
description: The nearly three-year war in Ukraine is at a crossroads. Trump promised to end the fighting within six months of taking office.

title: Blame Game Intensifies Over Deadly Kursk Missile Strike
description: Ukraine and Russia traded accusations over a missile strike in Russia's Kursk region that killed at least four people. The attack, involving heavy battles, targeted a boarding school near the Ukrainian border. Both nations claim the other was responsible, highlighting ongoing tensions and civilian casualties.

title: Crisis in Ukraine: Russia's Relentless Air Assault
description: Russia launched a significant drone and missile attack on Ukraine, resulting in 15 casualties and significant damage to residential and energy infrastructure. Attacks targeted central Ukraine's Poltava, Kharkiv, and other regions, causing destruction and disrupting military supply lines. Both nations exchanged blame for attacks on civilian areas.

title: Russian attacks on Ukraine power grid cause brief blackouts as US officials consider cease-fire push
description: Russia fired a barrage of drones and missiles at Ukraine on Saturday, killing 12 people and blasting its energy grid, officials said.

title: Dormitory Under Fire: A New Chapter in the Russia-Ukraine Conflict
description: Russian defense ministry reported a missile strike by Ukraine on a boarding school dormitory in Kursk. Ukraine previously accused Russian forces of attacking the same site, resulting in at least four casualties in the part held by Ukrainian forces.

title: Takeaways from the AP interview with Ukraine’s Zelenskyy
description: KYIV, Ukraine (AP) — The Associated Press interviewed Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Saturday at a crucial juncture of the nearly three-year war against Russia’s full-scale invasion.
